objective: Discover independent RANGE/BEAR alpha without using V9 TEST results for selection; preserve the existing I46 BULL LONG lane and treat CASH as a competing action.

data.point_in_time_rule: Only completed candles; signal on close of bar t; entry at Binance Futures bar t+1 open.
data.survivorship_limit: Current common Binance/Upbit universe is used because historical Upbit membership is unavailable; reported as a limitation.

split_protocol.test_access_rule: The test runner refuses to run until candidate-lock.json exists and its SHA-256 is recorded. TEST is evaluated once for the locked candidate set.

execution.entry: next completed 15m Binance Futures candle open
execution.exit: ATR bracket with conservative STOP_FIRST intrabar ordering, otherwise locked time exit
execution.funding: No funding event charge for holds <=4h; candidates crossing an 8h event are ineligible for promotion unless separately accounted.
execution.portfolio_signal_priority: For simultaneous eligible signals, sort by the candidate's dimensionless absolute trigger-excess strength descending, then asset ascending, then candidate key ascending; admit at most three and never admit a duplicate asset.

promotion_gates.neighbour_requirement: At least one pre-registered neighbouring configuration has positive aggregate validation stress and at least two positive stress folds.
promotion_gates.candidate_selection_priority: Among candidates passing every validation gate, lock exactly one: highest aggregate validation stress bps, then lowest stress max drawdown, then candidate key ascending.
promotion_gates.portfolio_requirement: Adding the lane to CASH for the same non-BULL timestamps must increase stress P&L without increasing max drawdown by more than the stress P&L gain.
promotion_gates.abstention: If no candidate passes every gate, RANGE/BEAR remain NO_TRADE.
